svg.title: ClickClick core architecture: harness, observation, session and skill learning
svg.desc: Lightweight MCP and Console interfaces connect to task management. The core is the Agent Harness, reliable device observation, durable Session and skill self-improvement. Skill Reviewer and selected execution checks establish quality; users inspect review and validation results and confirm publication. Published versions feed runtime skill delivery.
